tagline: Three-band EQ with switchable high-pass and low-pass filters
description: A three-band EQ: low shelf, mid peak and high shelf, each with frequency and ±12 dB gain, plus a high-pass and a low-pass filter that can be switched in. All five are biquad filters in series; input and output meters show the levels.

features.name: Low Shelf
features.description: 20 Hz to 500 Hz (default 80 Hz), ±12 dB, Q 0.707

features.name: Mid Peak
features.description: 200 Hz to 5 kHz (default 1 kHz), ±12 dB, fixed Q of 1.0

features.name: High Shelf
features.description: 2 kHz to 20 kHz (default 8 kHz), ±12 dB, Q 0.707

features.name: High-Pass Filter
features.description: Off by default; 20 Hz to 500 Hz, 12 dB/octave

features.name: Low-Pass Filter
features.description: Off by default; 2 kHz to 20 kHz, 12 dB/octave

useCases: Remove rumble - switch on the HPF at 40-80 Hz
Reduce harshness - cut the mid band at 2-4 kHz by 3-6 dB
Add air - boost the high shelf at 8-12 kHz by 2-4 dB
Telephone effect - HPF at 300 Hz and LPF at 3 kHz
Add weight - boost the low shelf at 80-120 Hz by 3-6 dB
learningFocus: Biquad filter design (shelf, peaking, HPF, LPF)
Recomputing coefficients only when a parameter changes
Cascaded filter processing (5 filters in series)

algorithms.name: Low Shelf Filter
algorithms.description: Bass boost or cut, using the shelf formulas from the RBJ Audio EQ Cookbook (Q=0.707)

algorithms.name: Peaking EQ
algorithms.description: Bell curve for the mid band (Q=1.0)
